label: CP-9(5)
title: Transfer to Alternate Storage Site

statement.prose: Transfer system backup information to the alternate storage site {{ insert: param, cp-9.5_prm_1 }}.

guidance: System backup information can be transferred to alternate storage sites either electronically or by the physical shipment of storage media.

params.label: organization-defined time period and transfer rate consistent with the recovery time and recovery point objectives
time period
guidelines: time period consistent with recovery time and recovery point objectives is defined;

params.label: transfer rate
guidelines: transfer rate consistent with recovery time and recovery point objectives is defined;
